objective: Adrian signs the emergency-intervention authorization, completing his enrollment in the experimental-medicine program and securing his financial lifeline, while confronting the final bureaucratic hurdle of the trial.
intendedChange: Adrian signs the emergency-intervention authorization, completing his enrollment in the experimental-medicine program and securing his financial lifeline, while confronting the final bureaucratic hurdle of the trial.
prohibitedPatterns: Introducing the catastrophic accident or nanite intervention
Revealing the nanites' interaction with the fertility drug
Adrian engaging in personal conversation with Dr. Thorne
Dr. Thorne offering emotional support or financial advice

scenes.purpose: Adrian arrives at the clinic for his daily visit, physically and mentally exhausted from the previous night's diner shift and the medication's side effects, and is directed by the receptionist to Room 4 for a mandatory final administrative review.
scenes.intendedChange: Adrian is seated in Room 4, physically present and waiting, with Dr. Thorne entering to begin the final enrollment procedure, establishing the immediate context for the signing.

scenes.purpose: Dr. Thorne presents the emergency-intervention authorization, explaining in clinical terms that it grants the research team permission to use experimental, unapproved treatments (including nanites) in the event of a life-threatening emergency, and Adrian reads the document, weighing the loss of bodily autonomy against the financial necessity of completing his enrollment.
scenes.intendedChange: Adrian has fully understood the scope of the authorization and the specific risk of surrendering control over his body in an emergency, and he is ready to make the decision, with the pen in his hand and the document open before him.

scenes.purpose: Adrian signs the emergency-intervention authorization without hesitation, demonstrating his complete commitment to the trial and his willingness to surrender control over his own body in an emergency to secure his financial survival, while Dr. Thorne observes his compliance with clinical detachment and files the document.
scenes.intendedChange: Adrian has successfully enrolled in the experimental-medicine program, is actively participating in the male-fertility trial, and has signed the emergency-intervention authorization, completing his enrollment and securing his financial lifeline.
